name: pharos_parallelism
description: How many agents were active at once, as occupancy facts: one row per local clock hour, counting unit, machine-wide level, and repository level, over the last 400 local days. Timing is estimated from transcript timestamps: a user-managed conversation is active from each prompt to its last response or tool result, with turns joined across gaps up to the Parallelism setting. Delegated agents are not separate units. Counting and gap follow the saved Parallelism settings.

fields.name: started_at
fields.label: Hour
fields.description: Start of the local clock hour. A daylight-saving day has 23 or 25 of them. Covers the last 400 local days.

fields.name: hour_of_day
fields.label: Hour of day
fields.description: Local clock hour, 00 to 23.

fields.name: counting
fields.label: Counting
fields.description: What one unit is, from the Parallelism setting: a checkout location (workspace), or a top-level conversation with its continuations (agent session).

fields.name: gap_minutes
fields.label: Gap joined (min)
fields.description: Idle minutes between a conversation's turns still counted as continuous work, from the Parallelism setting.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.label: Unit ID
fields.description: The checkout location (or Pharos workspace without one) when counting workspaces; the top-level conversation ID when counting agent sessions. Count distinct for units active.

fields.name: unit_label
fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Checkout folder name, or the top-level conversation's workspace title.

fields.name: repository_name
fields.label: Repository
fields.description: Repository of the unit's top-level workspace; empty when none is recorded.

fields.name: conversation_id
fields.label: Top-level conversation ID
fields.description: Set when counting agent sessions.

fields.name: provider
fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Top-level conversation's provider; set when counting agent sessions.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: Top-level conversation's recorded model; set when counting agent sessions.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Active at once
fields.description: Units active machine-wide during this time, including this one.

fields.name: repo_level
fields.label: Active in repository
fields.description: Units of the same repository active during this time, including this one.

fields.name: unit_ms
fields.label: Unit time (ms)
fields.description: Time this unit was active at this level. A sum counts parallel units separately (agent-time); ÷ elapsed is the average active at once.

fields.name: elapsed_ms
fields.label: Elapsed share (ms)
fields.description: Unit time ÷ level. Summed over all units it is wall-clock time with any unit active, never double-counting overlap.

fields.name: repo_elapsed_ms
fields.label: Repository elapsed share (ms)
fields.description: Unit time ÷ repository level. Summed over a repository's rows it is wall-clock time with any of its units active.

fields.name: parallel_elapsed_ms
fields.label: Parallel elapsed share (ms)
fields.description: Elapsed share while two or more units were active. Summed, wall-clock time with 2+ active.

fields.name: unit_hours
fields.label: Unit hours
fields.description: Unit time in hours.

fields.name: elapsed_hours
fields.label: Elapsed hours
fields.description: Elapsed share in hours.

fields.name: repo_elapsed_hours
fields.label: Repository elapsed hours
fields.description: Repository elapsed share in hours.

fields.name: parallel_elapsed_hours
fields.label: Parallel elapsed hours
fields.description: Parallel elapsed share in hours.
